title: Cerberus
summary: Cerberus is a three-headed, dog-like Titan who has flames for fur along with sharp teeth that can rip enemies apart and claws that are sharp enough to pin enemies down, making it a very dangerous Titan. Cerberus Amulets are in the possession of Marduk and Rahmas.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Cerberus inspired the Greco-Roman myth of a three-headed dog that was said to guard the gates to the Underworld, preventing the sprits of the dead from returning to the living world. {{Source|Cerberus (comic)}}

sections.heading: Rahmas's Cerberus
sections.wikitext: The Huntik team and [[Organization]] both went after a Cerberus Amulet. The missing [[Dante Vale]] was tricked into recovering the Amulet for [[Dr. Benway]], who took the Amulet from him and took him prisoner. He then summoned Cerberus in the Gates of Hell to attack [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Zhalia Moon]], and [[Kilthane]]. However, Dante teamed up with the recently double-crossed Organization agent, [[Rahmas]], to defeat Benway's forces. Dante then took Cerberus's Amulet but was unable to bond with it, due to being a hero and a "boy scout" as Rahmas put it. Dante reluctantly gave the Amulet to Rahmas who bonded with the Titan, in exchange for him calling Cerberus back from obliterating the team. Rahmas then left with the Titan. {{Source|Cerberus (comic)|Cerberus}}

sections.heading: Marduk's Cerberus
sections.wikitext:
Another Cerberus Titan was bonded to [[Marduk]], a member of the [[Blood Spiral]]. Cerberus was used by [[Marduk]] to fight [[Albion]] and [[Vigilante]] during an attempt to force [[Casterwill family]] knowledge from [[Focauld Casterwill]]. Cerberus overpowered the two Titans, but was defeated by a daring strike organized by [[Sophie Casterwill]]. {{Source|The Casterwill Connection}}

Marduk again invoked Cerberus to fight against the [[Casterwill family]] during the attack on the [[Fortress of Iron Will]]. Here, Cerberus attacked [[Sentinel]] and defeated him but was defeated when [[Nimue Casterwill]] used the combined powers of [[Soulburn]] and [[Sacroblade]]. {{Source|The Spiral War}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Cerberus' summoning command is "'''Hunt them, Cerberus!'''"
* Cerberus is the first [[Titan]] to appear in the ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'' comics before being introduced in the show with an overhauled design. His size went from being very large to an average-sized Titan and the colour of his body changed from brown to grey. 
* Although it is a Litho-Titan, the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cerberus Cerberus] was a creature from Greek mythology like most [[Krono-Titans]].

full_text:
Cerberus is a three-headed, dog-like Titan who has flames for fur along with sharp teeth that can rip enemies apart and claws that are sharp enough to pin enemies down, making it a very dangerous Titan. Cerberus Amulets are in the possession of Marduk and Rahmas.

==History==
Cerberus inspired the Greco-Roman myth of a three-headed dog that was said to guard the gates to the Underworld, preventing the sprits of the dead from returning to the living world. [Cerberus (comic)]

=== Rahmas's Cerberus ===
The Huntik team and Organization both went after a Cerberus Amulet. The missing Dante Vale was tricked into recovering the Amulet for Dr. Benway, who took the Amulet from him and took him prisoner. He then summoned Cerberus in the Gates of Hell to attack Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, Zhalia Moon, and Kilthane. However, Dante teamed up with the recently double-crossed Organization agent, Rahmas, to defeat Benway's forces. Dante then took Cerberus's Amulet but was unable to bond with it, due to being a hero and a "boy scout" as Rahmas put it. Dante reluctantly gave the Amulet to Rahmas who bonded with the Titan, in exchange for him calling Cerberus back from obliterating the team. Rahmas then left with the Titan. [Cerberus (comic)]

=== Marduk's Cerberus ===
Another Cerberus Titan was bonded to Marduk, a member of the Blood Spiral. Cerberus was used by Marduk to fight Albion and Vigilante during an attempt to force Casterwill family knowledge from Focauld Casterwill. Cerberus overpowered the two Titans, but was defeated by a daring strike organized by Sophie Casterwill. [The Casterwill Connection]

Marduk again invoked Cerberus to fight against the Casterwill family during the attack on the Fortress of Iron Will. Here, Cerberus attacked Sentinel and defeated him but was defeated when Nimue Casterwill used the combined powers of Soulburn and Sacroblade. [The Spiral War]

Cerberus is also quite resistant to attacks, as when it was stabbed in the chest by Vigilante with no effect. ==Trivia==
* Cerberus' summoning command is "Hunt them, Cerberus!"
* Cerberus is the first Titan to appear in the Huntik Magazine comics before being introduced in the show with an overhauled design. His size went from being very large to an average-sized Titan and the colour of his body changed from brown to grey. 
* Although it is a Litho-Titan, the Cerberus was a creature from Greek mythology like most Krono-Titans.
